activity.notes: Gush X'een is preserved in Tlingit historical tradition as an early Shtax'heen leader associated with the origin of the Sheiyksh (Shakes) chiefly title. The chronology is an oral-history reconstruction rather than a precisely dated documentary term, so both boundaries are approximate and confidence is likely rather than well_established.

sources.title: The Alaska Tlingit: Where Did We Come From? — William Lewis Paul, Shquindy
sources.citation_text: William Lewis Paul's Tlingit historical account preserves the tradition of Gush X'een as an early chief and the origin history of the Sheiyksh/Shakes title, in an approximately early-eighteenth-century setting.
